messages:
anya: Quick thread — final run-of-show draft for Wed's webinar "Pragmatic LLM Serving: real-world tradeoffs". Please confirm slots and who will moderate Q&A.

matt: Looks good. I can handle the intro + product roadmap slide. Do we have a 5-minute product demo or 3?

anya: 3-minute demo to keep time for panel. Speakers: Jordan (runtime optimizations), Sophia (dedicated/private deployments), Matt (product + demo), Sam (moderator). @jordan @sophia please confirm.

jordan: confirmed. I'll do 12–15m deep dive on kernel selection and batching, 2 slides with perf graphs.

sophia: confirmed. I'll cover deployment options & security for 10m. Need the latest SLA numbers — @matt can you drop them in the shared slide deck?

matt: dropping numbers now: https://slides.redwood.sh/s/serving-sla-figs (link). Demo will be 3m, single flow.

sam: I'll moderate. Suggest we collect 3 audience questions from registration and pick 2 live + 1 from Slack.

anya: run-of-show below (times are minutes). Please review.

```
0:00 — Host intro + agenda (Sam) 3m
0:03 — Product demo (Matt) 3m
0:06 — Runtime deep dive (Jordan) 12m
0:18 — Deployment & compliance (Sophia) 10m
0:28 — Panel discussion (all speakers) 12m
0:40 — Live Q&A (audience + Slack) 15m
0:55 — Closing & CTA (Matt) 5m
Total: 60m
```

matt: can we shave panel to 10 and give Q&A 17? attendees ask more questions usually.

anya: fine, adjust: panel 10, Q&A 17, closing 3 — updated.

marketing-bot: Reminder set — rehearsal scheduled Tue 11:00 PT. Calendar invites sent to: @jordan @sophia @matt @sam (link: https://calendar.redwood.sh/event/1782150000)

jordan: I'll rehearse my demo transitions with Matt today at 3pm.

sophia: need slide template for compliance callouts — @anya can you push to deck?

anya: done — added template section "Compliance bullets" slide 10. Also added speaker notes for transitions.

matt: thumbs up :thumbsup: Also prepping 2 benchmark snippets for the runtime talk — 1 short, 1 detailed.

sam: any pre-registered audience segments we should call out? enterprises vs startups?

anya: yes — registration shows 40% enterprise, 35% startups, rest platform teams. Plan to call out enterprise SLAs and private deployment examples.

sophia: ack. I'll emphasize KMS/HSM and audit logs.

anya: final ask — please confirm you can make Tue rehearsal 11:00 PT. Reply with yes/no.

jordan: yes

sophia: yes

matt: yes

sam: yes

anya: thanks all. I'll lock the deck and share final link by EOD.
